title: Oxikube aliases.json
description: Your own names for the ':' jump bar. Each key is an alias (case-insensitive, no spaces and none of / @ = ,); the value is where it leads. Your aliases win over the built-in k9s ones (po, dp, svc, ...) and over names the cluster's API discovery adds.

oneOf.description: A resource as group/version/plural ("apps/v1/deployments", "v1/pods" for the core group), or a jump-bar command line ("pod fred app=blee", "ctx prod"). A string with a '/' and no spaces is a resource; anything else is a command line.
A command with arguments: the first word of a jump-bar command line and the rest.

command.description: The first word: a resource alias ("pod"), a jump-bar word ("ctx") or a command id ("pod::Delete").
